title: feat(types,plugin-chatbot)!: retire the unhonourable maxToolRoundtrips chatbot key behind a tombstone (objectui#5605)
body:
Fixes #5605
Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — a published, authorable key (`maxToolRoundtrips` on `chatbot`, `chatbot-enhanced`, `chatbot-floating`) is now refused by name, and `UseObjectChatOptions` / `ChatbotSharedKey` lose the member. Both packages ship `minor` with a BREAKING (authoring) banner; no `major`.

## What changed

The chat key `maxToolRoundtrips` is retired behind an ADR-0049 tombstone. Enforcing it is out of reach from a chat node (see H1 / H2 below).

- **`@object-ui/types`**
  - `ChatbotSchema.maxToolRoundtrips` is now a `?: never` tombstone with a JSDoc note. `ChatbotEnhancedSchema` and `ChatbotFloatingSchema` pick it by name, so all three faces share one declaration.
  - On the zod twins the member is a `retirementTombstone(...)` whose message names the agent's `planning.maxIterations`. The two twins reference `ChatbotSchema.shape.maxToolRoundtrips`, so one arm serves all three.
  - The key leaves `ChatbotSharedKey`, the shared zod pick, the five "What it renders instead" key lists (chatbot `children`; enhanced and floating `body` and `children`) and the three JSDoc read lists.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`**
  - Removed: `UseObjectChatOptions.maxToolRoundtrips`, the stage-1 one-time notice (`warnMaxToolRoundtripsInert`, `resetMaxToolRoundtripsWarning`, `warnedInertMaxToolRoundtrips`, its `useEffect`), the three `renderer.tsx` pass-throughs and the header-comment mention.
  - None of the removed helpers was exported from the package entry. `index.tsx` re-exports only `useObjectChat`, the two option/return types, `ObjectChatMessage`, `AI_USAGE_REFRESH_EVENT` and `emitAiUsageRefresh` from `useObjectChat.ts`, and the package publishes `.` only. So the only public move is the `UseObjectChatOptions` member.
- **Docs** (`content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx`): the code-block line and the props-table row are removed. A short paragraph says that tool-loop caps live on the agent (`planning.maxIterations`) and that the key is refused on all three chat nodes.
- **Pending changesets whose text goes false** each get a dated note in the objectui#10533 form, with frontmatter byte-identical:
  - `max-tool-roundtrips-deprecate-5605.md`: whole file md5 `88ef3897631aa65db0ed32dd7dd21ed7` before, `f43cd20e456a7e4fa552bb77d840cb89` after. Frontmatter md5 `3afbd0e74664dde336d7a3099e216bff` before and after.
  - `6687-chatbot-surface-authorable.md`: frontmatter md5 `940fe42d725e5ff52706533d7a69ff97` before and after.
  - `7655-chatbot-registration-authoring-faces.md`: its "twenty keys" census becomes nineteen. Frontmatter md5 `c2ebce04fdeea00b067e188003b8b6a3` before and after.
- **New changesets:** `5605-retire-max-tool-roundtrips-types.md` and `5605-retire-max-tool-roundtrips-plugin-chatbot.md`. Each is `minor`, carries the **BREAKING (authoring)** banner, and has the migration line "remove `maxToolRoundtrips`; cap tool loops on the agent (`planning.maxIterations`)".

## H1 / H2: why enforce is not reachable (measured in round 1, report comment 5857774906)

- **Transport.** `useObjectChat` calls `@ai-sdk/react@4.0.68` `useChat` with exactly `transport` (`DefaultChatTransport` from `ai@7.0.65`), `messages` and `onError`. It passes no `onToolCall` and no `sendAutomaticallyWhen`, so the client never re-POSTs.
- **Where the loop runs: on the server.** A one-off probe (never committed) measured this:
  - a stream ending on an unresolved tool call gave 1 POST;
  - a stream carrying three server-run tool steps gave 1 POST;
  - control: the same SDK with a client loop opted in re-POSTed 3 times, so the harness does see repeat POSTs.
- **No cap knob on the client.** `ChatInit` declares one loop control, the boolean predicate `sendAutomaticallyWhen`, and no numeric cap. `maxSteps` / `maxToolRoundtrips` have 0 occurrences in `ai`'s `dist/index.d.ts`.
- **No cap field on the wire.** `AiChatRequestSchema` and `AiAgentChatRequestSchema` in `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 and on objectstack `main` declare none. The platform's cap is agent metadata: `planning.maxIterations`, default 10.
- **Not measured:** the cloud `service-ai` source, which this session cannot read.

## Ruling

Seat ruling comment 5857793569 on this card chose **A, retire now, with a tombstone**, per triage direction 5857452610 point 4 ("If the transport in use cannot honour a cap … the key retires instead"). It picked tombstone over plain deletion because `BaseSchema` is `.passthrough()`, so a deleted arm would keep an authored value in silence.

## Pins and ablation

## Serial

`git merge-tree --write-tree` against a freshly fetched `origin/main` (`a14fb23b3b`) exits 0. None of the files `main` gained since this branch's base touches `plugin-chatbot`, `complex.ts`, `complex.zod.ts` or the three changesets annotated here.

## Acceptance notes

- **The tombstone is on all three chat nodes, not only `chatbot`.** The key was declared on `chatbot-enhanced` and `chatbot-floating` through the shared pick. Dropping it from the pick alone would have left those two faces silently accepting it through `.passthrough()`. So each twin carries the same arm, and the TypeScript faces pick the same `?: never` member.
- **The TypeScript member is `?: never`, not deleted outright.** This is the package's retirement convention on both faces (`height`, `loading`, …). A deleted TypeScript member beside a zod tombstone would be a new `MirroredUndeclared` entry in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`.
- **`ChatbotSharedKey` is a published type** (via the `@object-ui/types/complex` subpath), and it loses `'maxToolRoundtrips'`. This is named in the `@object-ui/types` changeset's banner.
- The root `CHANGELOG.md` has one historical line introducing the field. No `CHANGELOG.md` mentions its deprecation, which confirms the stage-1 deprecation never shipped.
- Out of scope: the stage-2 card objectui#5919 keeps its `duplicate` state; nothing here touches it.


## Rounds 2 and 3

- **The round-1 contract review** (the record on this PR; the seat's ruling is `5857793569` on the card) passed ruling fidelity, cleanup, semver, the dated notes, the pins and CI. It FAILED on two "twenty" census texts that this PR's narrowing of `ChatbotSharedKey` (20 → 19) makes false.
- **Round 3** (`c4f1e22d6b`, text only):
  - `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` reads "the nineteen shared rows below", re-counted at head;
  - the header of the 7655 test reads "the keys all three read (twenty at objectui#7655, nineteen since objectui#5605 retired `maxToolRoundtrips`)";
  - two optional wordings are taken: the types changeset names `ChatbotEnhancedSchema` / `ChatbotFloatingSchema` instead of "the two twins", and the 7655 dated note says `ChatbotSchema` declares the member and the other two faces pick it.
  - Frontmatter md5 is unchanged on both changesets. `git merge-tree --write-tree` against a fresh `origin/main` is clean.
- **Body:** the key-list count above is corrected from four to five, by the seat at landing.
